scope: Offline read-only EV90 preflight; no Q/EV88 candidate read, no solver, no candidate output.
limitations: No terrain/render engine or wave envelope; the test is static compiled ODOL triangle height against nominal P/F fields.
Buried faces are included: current terrain height is not used to cull model faces.
The source 0WZD transforms are linked by B deploy/PBO hashes; transforms are not parsed from the compiled OPRW payload.

The focal box-feasibility calculation is optimistic and separable; it is a bound-only necessary/sufficient test for scalar intervals, not a coupled terrain solve or proof that other geometry gates pass.
Any intersecting undefined P/F domain or partial F affecting an originally eligible node leaves the overall result INCONCLUSIVE; no field is imputed.
